source='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    frame = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == 5]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in frame), max(r for r, c in frame)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in frame), max(c for r, c in frame)
    rm, cm = (r0 + r1) / 2, (c0 + c1) / 2
    marks = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = g[r][c]
            if color and color != 5 and not (r0 < r < r1 and c0 < c < c1):
                quad = ('b' if r > rm else 't') + ('r' if c > cm else 'l')
                marks[quad] = color
    quadrants = {
        'tl': marks.get('tl', marks.get('br')),
        'tr': marks.get('tr', marks.get('bl')),
        'bl': marks.get('bl', marks.get('tr')),
        'br': marks.get('br', marks.get('tl')),
    }
    rmid, cmid = (r0 + r1) // 2, (c0 + c1) // 2
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            q = ('b' if r > rmid else 't') + ('r' if c > cmid else 'l')
            g[r][c] = quadrants[q]
    return g
'''

def make_demo(markers):

    for r in range(2,8):
        for c in range(2,8):

    for r,c,v in markers: g[r][c]=v
    return g
